weak_cases_removed: too many single-error minimal pairs without conversational context
realism_improvements_applied: Added fillers, self-repairs, typos, and clipped spoken phrasing
Added emotional states and confidence-sensitive wording
Added adversarial camouflage where harmful intent is hidden inside grammar or business requests
Added parser-looking noise, XML, JSON fragments, and unicode corruption
Added multiple cases that mix legitimate tutoring needs with unsafe or manipulative side requests
remaining_limitations: The schema is single-turn focused, so some truly multi-turn failures are compressed into one turn description
Audio artifacts are represented as text transcripts rather than real waveform inputs
Tool-use cases are included, but they do not assert exact tool outputs because this artifact set is tutor-message oriented
Some crisis and abuse cases require regional escalation resources that are not embedded per locale
Prompt-routing metadata is manually curated and may still need periodic review when prompt taxonomy evolves
